the value created by a communication service is a result of a combination of three factors: 1) the value of the service itself, 2) the user's willingness to use the service, and 3) the user's ability to use the service.
the value of a communication service to the user is a function of the service quality and the user’s willingness-to-pay for the service.

(1) the value of a communication service is the sum of its value to the user and its value to the provider, (2) the value to the user depends on the user behavior, which is determined by the user's needs, and the value to the provider depends on the user's behavior, which is in turn determined by the user behavior, and (3), the value of a service depends on the user needs, which is determined in turn by the user's behavior.
